text:
noah (Account Exec): quick one — Mistral Health onboarding stalled. they asked for a short grace pricing window: 3 months reduced incremental rate + a small onboarding credit so they don't pause Dedicated instance. need finance OK.
sumi (Sales Ops): Context: committed monthly = 200M tokens, expected drop to 120M for ~3 months during integration. legal ok w/ amendment. customer asks that concession only apply to incremental usage above floor.
noah (Account Exec): proposed: $6,000 one-time onboarding credit + per-token incremental rate 0.0030 -> 0.0020 for 3 months (only on usage above committed floor). routing to @elin for approval & GL tagging.
elin (Finance): need revenue impact numbers and whether credit is to be amortized. also confirm temporary vs permanent.
noah (Account Exec): temporary amendment only, auto-revert. quick calc below (rounded):
```
current_rate = 0.0030
proposed_rate = 0.0020
expected_tokens_during_reduction = 120000000
delta = current_rate - proposed_rate = 0.0010
monthly_customer_savings = delta * expected_tokens_during_reduction = 0.0010 * 120,000,000 = $120,000
3mo_savings = $360,000
one_time_credit = $6,000
approx_revenue_impact = $366,000 loss over 3 months
```
note: applies to incremental only. attaching SFDC opp after this chat.
sumi (Sales Ops): confirmed committed floor unchanged. we'll add clause. I'll attach draft amendment to SFDC and create OPS ticket for rate override.
elin (Finance): GL: use promo-credits-2026-SZ. amortize $6k over 2 months. conditional approval: yes to $6k credit + temporary incremental rate 0.0020 for 3 months provided: 1) signed amendment with "incremental only" language, 2) SFDC opp updated, 3) OPS ticket exists and references amendment. finance will sign off in Jira once items present.
ravi (RevOps): created OPS-8123 to implement override. won't deploy until amendment and GL confirmed.
billing-bot: Note: billing will schedule rate override window once OPS-8123 is marked ready and finance confirms. suggested effective window: 2026-07-01 -> 2026-09-30.
elin (Finance): adding: please ensure the amendment has explicit auto-revert date and no change to committed floor. Once OPS-8123 shows amendment attached and GL set, finance will instruct billing to apply credit.
noah (Account Exec): thanks all : will get legal to sign today and attach.
sumi (Sales Ops): saving thread for audit. :lock:
